en.currentViewDefaultSaved: Current view will be used by default
en.helpRainCopy: Use the bottom buttons to switch the accumulated rain period. The current period changes immediately and does not overwrite your saved preference.
en.helpStationsClick: Tap or click a station to open its details.
en.helpStationsHover: On desktop, hover over stations from zoom 7 to preview their details.
en.helpStationsHistory: Station popups include total rain, last reading, temperature, humidity, wind and recent daily history when available.
en.helpControlsSettings: The settings button opens filters, language, preferred period, saved view and terrain options.
en.helpControlsTerrain: The 2D/3D button toggles terrain without saving the preference.
en.helpControlsLayers: The layer button switches quickly between Satellite+, Hybrid, Topographic and Liberty.
en.helpControlsNorth: The compass button returns the map to north.
en.helpControlsCredits: The info button shows map, elevation and data credits.
en.helpFiltersRain: Min rain hides stations below the selected accumulated rain.
en.helpFiltersSource: Source filters show or hide Meteocat, Meteoclimatic, Wunderground, AEMET and unknown stations.
en.helpFiltersHistory: Last rains history controls how many recent records are shown in popups.
en.helpFiltersSave: Settings are saved for this device only when you close Settings after changing a setting.
en.helpFiltersView: Use Set current view as default in Settings to choose the initial map position for this device.
en.helpTerrainLongPress: Long-press the map to query terrain altitude and the nearest rainy station for the current period.
en.helpTerrainDem: Terrain and altitude use an external DEM service, so they can be unavailable if that service fails.
en.helpDataStatus: Source badges show whether each data source is OK, stale, disabled, pending or unavailable.
en.helpDataInvalid: Invalid counts in the header mean some loaded stations were ignored because their coordinates are not usable.
en.helpDataAuth: This protected viewer uses your Rainmapper login and device registration.
en.signInProtected: Sign in to view protected maps from this device.
en.signInViewMap: Sign in to view this map.
en.passwordReset: Your password was reset by an administrator. Choose a different password to continue.
en.enterNewPassword: Enter a new password to continue.
en.noRainyStation: No station with rain in the current map for {period}.
en.sourceStatusUnavailable: No source status available for the loaded data.

es.helpControlsNorth: El botón de brújula orienta el mapa al norte.
es.helpControlsCredits: El botón de información muestra créditos de mapa, relieve y datos.

es.helpFiltersHistory: Histórico de lluvias controla cuántos registros recientes se muestran en las fichas.
es.helpFiltersSave: Los ajustes se guardan solo para este dispositivo al cerrar Ajustes después de cambiar algo.
es.helpFiltersView: Usa Usar vista actual por defecto en Ajustes para elegir la posición inicial del mapa en este dispositivo.
es.helpTerrainLongPress: Mantén pulsado el mapa para consultar la altitud del terreno y la estación con lluvia más cercana en el periodo actual.

es.helpDataInvalid: El contador de inválidas en la cabecera indica que algunas estaciones cargadas se ignoraron porque sus coordenadas no son utilizables.

es.signInProtected: Entra para ver mapas protegidos desde este dispositivo.
